heading.title: Of Discharge from Liability on Notes, Bills and Cheques

article.title: Acceptor or indorser bound notwithstanding previous alteration.
article.content: An acceptor or indorser of a negotiable instrument is bound by his acceptance or indorsement notwithstanding any previous alteration of the instrument.
article.html:
88Acceptor or indorser bound notwithstanding previous alteration.

Section 88 · Chapter VII · page 21 of the Act

An acceptor or indorser of a negotiable instrument is bound by his acceptance or indorsement notwithstanding any previous alteration of the instrument.
